name: DuckDuckGo Instant Answers
description: Keyless access to DuckDuckGo Instant Answers: topic summaries, definitions, disambiguation and related topics. This is not a full web search results API.

tools.name: instant_answer
tools.description: Retrieve DuckDuckGo instant-answer data for a topic, including abstract, definition, answer and related topics when available. Does not return general web search links.

query.description: A topic, entity, term or question for an instant answer.
